posts.materialUpdate: Emaar's live Valia page confirms 1–4BR apartments and a starting price of AED 1.96 million; dated broker material reports sales opening on 31 August 2026.
posts.body:
VALIA — DUBAI CREEK HARBOUR

Emaar has launched Valia, a waterfront residential tower with 1–4 bedroom apartments. Emaar's official page confirms prices from AED 1.96 million.

Current broker material indicates an 80/20 payment plan and Q4 2030 handover; those commercial terms still need confirmation against Emaar's sales documents.

posts.materialUpdate: Wasl announced Avenue Park Towers II on 9 September 2026, opened registration and marked the project launching soon.
posts.body:
AVENUE PARK TOWERS II — LAUNCHING SOON

Wasl has opened registration for the final development within Wasl 1, beside Zabeel Park and within walking distance of Max Metro Station.

DLD-derived records indicate 1–4 bedroom apartments plus offices and retail. Wasl has not yet released the sales-opening date or starting prices.
